name: B10-0388/2026 (The Left) – Evaluation of the Common Fisheries Policy and follow-up
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the evaluation of the Common Fisheries Policy and follow-up
part_text:
**What it asks for**

This is an opinion, not a change in the law. The European Parliament welcomes the European Commission's review of the common fisheries policy, the European Union's rules on fishing. It says the rules are still fit for purpose but were not fully applied, and the 2020 target to end overfishing was missed. It asks for better enforcement, more support for small-scale fishers, action on climate and nature loss, and no weakening of environmental standards in the name of simplification.

**Key points**

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament sets out demands and offers to work with the Commission and Council.
- **Who it affects:** Small-scale fishers, fish farmers, coastal communities, and national governments that apply the rules.
- **What happens next:** Parliament sends the text to the Council and Commission; follow-up depends on them.
